pedagogy.title: EARLY RISK-OFF playbook in 4 lines
pedagogy.content: (1) Tilt defensive — staples, healthcare, utilities outperform when growth multiple compresses. (2) Pullback over Breakout — in negative-drift regime, momentum names get sold; only buy at support after a controlled retracement. (3) Position size halved — expected DD jumped from 2.9% to 4.78%; cut nominal exposure to keep portfolio-level VaR constant. (4) Gold + duration — GLD and TLT (when TLT pulls back) are the cleanest portfolio hedges. The risk-off tape doesn't necessarily mean crash — it means lower expected return and higher tail risk per unit of beta. Match the regime, don't fight it.
